title: Shingle Calculator
benefit: Bundles, Starter, Ridge Cap, and Nails
metaDescription: Estimate roof squares, shingle bundles with waste, starter strip, ridge cap, underlayment rolls, and nails from your roof size and pitch, in US units.
secondaryKeywords: how many bundles of shingles do i need
how many bundles of shingles in a square
how much underlayment do i need roof
intent: Estimate roofing squares, shingle bundles, and accessory quantities (starter, ridge cap, underlayment, nails) for a roof.
registerRow: Keyword Register: shingle calculator (Volume 1, Competition ease 4, Ad value 4, Fit 5, Priority 16)
intro: Enter your roof's footprint, pitch, and edge lengths to get roof squares, field shingle bundles before and after waste, and a shopping list of starter strip, ridge cap, underlayment, and nails. Accessory coverage loads from GAF or Owens Corning data sheets, or you can type your own.
uniqueAddition: Itemized shopping list grouped into field shingles, accessories, and fasteners, with starter, ridge cap, and underlayment worked out from eave, rake, and ridge lengths and a product selector that loads coverage from cited GAF and Owens Corning data sheets. Includes a bar chart of bundles by type and an accessory coverage comparison table.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: Footprint length
inputs.help: 10 to 200 ft. Measure the house's long side and add both roof overhangs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Footprint width
inputs.help: 10 to 100 ft. The short side, also including both overhangs.

inputs.name: pitchMode
inputs.label: Enter slope as
inputs.help: Use the multiplier if you already have one, for example from the Roof Pitch Calculator.

inputs.name: pitch
inputs.label: Roof pitch
inputs.help: 2 to 24. A 6/12 roof rises 6 in for every 12 in across. The 2024 IRC allows asphalt shingles only at 2/12 or steeper.

inputs.name: multiplier
inputs.label: Pitch multiplier
inputs.help: 1.014 to 2.5. Roof area divided by footprint area, e.g. 1.118 for a 6/12 roof.

inputs.name: eave
inputs.label: Eave length
inputs.help: 0 to 500 ft. Total of the bottom (gutter) edges. Starter strip runs here.

inputs.name: rake
inputs.label: Rake length
inputs.help: 0 to 500 ft. Total of the sloped gable edges. Enter 0 if you won't use starter on the rakes.

inputs.name: ridgeHip
inputs.label: Ridge + hip length
inputs.help: 0 to 500 ft. All ridges plus all hips. These get ridge cap shingles.

inputs.name: bundlesPerSquare
inputs.label: Bundles per square
inputs.help: 3 to 5. GAF Timberline HDZ is 3 bundles per square (100 sq ft). Check your shingle's wrapper.

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Waste allowance
inputs.help: 5 to 25%. 10% suits a simple gable roof. Use 15% or more for hips, valleys, and dormers, which need more cuts.

inputs.name: product
inputs.label: Accessory product line

options.label: Owens Corning: Starter Strip Plus, ProEdge, ProArmor

inputs.help: Loads the coverage values below from the maker's data sheet. Change any value to match the product you buy.

inputs.name: starterCoverage
inputs.label: Starter coverage
inputs.help: 50 to 200. GAF Pro-Start: about 120.33 lin ft per bundle.

inputs.name: ridgeCoverage
inputs.label: Ridge-cap coverage
inputs.help: 15 to 45. GAF Seal-A-Ridge: about 25 lin ft per bundle.

inputs.name: underlaymentCoverage
inputs.label: Underlayment roll coverage
inputs.help: 200 to 1,000. Net of laps. GAF FeltBuster is 1,000 sq ft before laps (937.5 after 3 in side laps).

inputs.name: nailsPerSquare
inputs.label: Nails per square
inputs.help: 100 to 400. GAF Timberline HDZ: 256 (4 per shingle). Some codes and high-wind installs need 6 per shingle (384).
